title: Cate Le Bon - About Time
blurb: New Cate Le Bon single. She's honestly one of the best artists I've seen live recently. This new record has a bit of a Connan Mockasin vibe.

title: Ela Minus - they told us it was hard, but they were wrong
blurb: I've slept on this one for a while. I don't know much about her, but it reminds me of The Knife.

title: Viagra Boys - Man Made of Meat
blurb: This is the new Viagra Boys tune. It's obviously absolutely banging!

title: Ex-Easter Island Head - Norther
blurb: Another band that have been around a little while, and I'm only just getting into them. Won't be to everyone's taste.

title: Cameron Winter - Drinking Age
blurb: Honestly, I think this is one of the best albums of the year. It's not for everyone, almost sounds like a cross between Bill Callahan and Car Seat Headrest.

title: Blawan - NOS
blurb: Another banger from Blawan, who recently signed to XL Recordings. Please come to New Zealand!

title: Geordie Greep - Holy Holy
blurb: I know this came out last year and isn't exactly new, but it slaps. I think he's great—probably not to everyone's tastes.

title: Freddie Gibbs & The Alchemist - Ensalada
blurb: The last couple of albums with Madlib were great. I'm not sure about this album, but this track is an absolute banger.

title: Bodhi - Bellcurve
blurb: I heard this in Phonica last week. Kind of melodic techno vibes. I thought it was pretty cool, worth a listen if you're into that sort of thing.

title: Oakland - Bad Em Up
blurb: I think this one goes back to around 2006/07. I've had it stuck in my head for a couple of days.

title: TVOD - Uniform
blurb: I don't really know much about this band, but they played End of the Road this year and seem to be on their way up.

title: Kassie Krut - Reckless
blurb: Someone recommended this to me recently. Worth a listen.

title: Thee Oh Sees - Enemy Destruct
blurb: I was gutted to miss them when they played Auckland earlier this year. One of my favourites. It's such a cool record cover.

title: Lime Garden - Love Song
blurb: Band from Brighton. It's good, kind of indie pop.
